objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched for selection, ranked or selected (AD1). The study investigates one CPU/GPU parity mismatch, hardens the dataset export, audits host-path performance and, only if every gate passes, renews the GPU acceptance; its outcomes are a root-cause verdict by the frozen rule (PROTOCOL.md section 4.7), engineering changes with tests, kept/rejected performance changes by the frozen rule (section 6.3) and engineering gates (section 7).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals for selection. backendEvaluations caps fresh CPU reference pooled simulations on real data (root-cause reproductions, the parity campaign's CPU references, the CPU arm of the parity-only mini-optimization, CPU samples of the reliability run). GPU evaluations (non-official parity runs, replays of sealed jobs, benchmarks) are counted separately in the records; synthetic fixtures are not counted.

evaluationBackend.justification: Engineering diagnostic and acceptance study (GPU Phase 5): CPU evaluations are parity references and root-cause diagnostics; GPU runs are non-official parity tests, replays of sealed jobs and benchmarks. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 3.0.0 section 9.8); the engineering output, if every gate passes, is a new acceptance record (section 9.9) for the final code.

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search for selection and no chronological verdict (AD2)

deviations.description: no roles and no primary; nothing is selected
deviations.justification: brief: engineering assignment; no trading behavior, optimization decision or methodology change

deviations.description: no search for selection, no chronological verdict; sealed jobs of Assignments 3 and 2 replayed with their own frozen code and seeds, and the parity-only mini schedule, compared by identity only
deviations.justification: brief sections 3.1, 4: representative sealed-job replays and fixed-seed mini optimization compared by identity

deviations.description: D19, D21, D23, D24, FULL, the regime windows and episodes and the seeded fixtures opened quietly through the study's own door log for parity references, replays and benchmarks
deviations.justification: brief sections 1, 4: reproduction on the exact D24-fund configuration; parity on real historical market doors

deviations.description: the CPU engine is the unmodified canonical reference (no file of the CPU closure is edited); every result of the final path must reproduce the canonical or sealed records bit for bit
deviations.justification: brief: without changing trading behavior; zero-mismatch policy preserved

deviations.description: not applicable: no fold primary or final candidate
benchmarks measure the evaluator host path (the study subject), never a trading parameter; worker count and batch size stay Phase 4 decisions
deviations.justification: brief section 3: focused code-efficiency review; no repeat of the 1-4 concurrency study

deviations.description: stricter: no money figure of a searched configuration is reported as a finding; the one failing parity candidate's record appears only as diagnostic evidence of field identity
deviations.justification: brief: no new trading candidate is optimized here

deviations.description: one bounded 30-35 min reliability run on the final candidate instead of an endurance test
deviations.justification: brief section 4: approximately 30-60 minutes; no eight-hour endurance run

deviations.description: the risk-envelope pilot is out of scope: nothing of it is created, implemented, preflighted or run
deviations.justification: brief: strict boundary (the user's instructions take precedence, section 0.4)
